        return self

        return self

class SimpleEnsembleClassifier(BaseEstimator, ClassifierMixin):
    def __init__(self, classifiers, weights=None):

        self.weights = weights if weights is not None else [1.0] * len(classifiers)
        
    def fit(self, X, y):

        self.classes_ = unique_labels(y)

        return self

        X = check_array(X)
        probabilities = np.zeros((X.shape[0], len(self.classes_)))
        
        for clf, weight in zip(self.classifiers, self.weights):
            probabilities += weight * clf.predict_proba(X)
            
        probabilities /= sum(self.weights)
        return probabilities
